messages:
alice: heads-up — nightly eval after canary -> v26 is showing a large regress on legal_summaries promptset. many summaries are abruptly short/truncated. canary was 5% traffic.
alice: sample pair (v25.3 -> v26):
```
v25.3: The contract requires the supplier to deliver all goods within thirty days. Failure to deliver will trigger the liquidated damages clause and allow the buyer to seek remedies including termination and reimbursement of reasonable costs.
v26: The contract requires the supplier to deliver all goods within thirty days. Failure to deliver will trigger the
```
alice: v26 often cuts at punctuation or emits an early EOS token. not just a single case — reproducible across ~40/200 prompts in the suite.
eval-bot: nightly report: summary-briefness metric regressed +18% vs baseline (v25.3). avg token length per summary dropped 320 -> 198. failures: 42/200. full stats: https://internal-evals.redwood/builds/3287654321 (CI artifact)
ben: curious — tokenizer merge table changed in token-lib v3.2.0 that shipped with v26 weights. I saw mergeset reorder that splits some legal compounds differently. quick diff:
```
"non-disclosure" -> v25.3 tokens: ["non", "-", "disclosure"] (3 tokens)
"non-disclosure" -> v26 tokens: ["non-d", "isclosure"] (2 tokens)
```
ben: that changes alignment of token positions; if decoding heuristics rely on token boundaries for structured-stop heuristics we could hit an early EOS bias.
cara: also worth checking quantization: v26 in canary used int8-symmetric config from quant-tool v0.9. In my past experiments int8 scale shifts can nudge softmax tail and amplify EOS logits. can someone run reproducer with these combos?
cara: repro command I ran locally (adjust paths):
```
redwood-run --model v26 --tokenizer tokenlib-v3.2.0 --quant int8 --promptset legal_summaries --limit 50 --save-logs /tmp/repro_v26_int8
redwood-run --model v25.3 --tokenizer tokenlib-v2.8.1 --quant fp16 --promptset legal_summaries --limit 50 --save-logs /tmp/repro_v25_fp16
```
ben: I attached a minimal logits snippet for one failing prompt — v26 shows a sharp EOS logit spike at step 14, v25.3 is smoother:
```
# v25.3 logits (last 6 tokens): [-3.1, -2.9, -2.7, -2.5, -2.3, -2.2]
# v26 logits (last 6 tokens): [-3.4, -3.0, -1.8, 0.9, 4.2, 12.7]  # EOS pinching
```
alice: good catch. action items I propose:
- pin canary back to v25.3 (stop rollout) until triage complete
- run cross-combinations: (v25.3 weights + tokenlib-v3), (v26 weights + tokenlib-v2) to isolate tokenizer vs weights
- run int8 vs fp16 on failing subset (50 prompts) and collect logits + tokenization diffs
- add legal_summaries to higher-priority regression set so CI alerts earlier
alice: who can own the cross-combo runs? can we have results in the next 2 hours? I can coordinate infra.
ben: I can run weight+tokenizer cross tests (will use repro script). starting now, ETA ~90m for full 50 prompts with logs.
cara: I'll run quant comparison (int8 vs fp16) on the same 50 prompts. will push logs to the eval artifact store and tag the failing indices.
dan: infra / rollout notes: created ticket RW-3210 (triage: v26 summarization truncation). canary pinned by infra-bot at 3287654350. Added owners: ben, cara, alice. I scheduled a 30m ad-hoc triage at 3287654400 UTC.
alice: thanks — after we have cross-run matrix we should decide rollback vs tokenizer-pin. also add a short unit test that asserts avg token-length delta < 10% to catch regressions sooner.
eval-bot: logging: attached artifact bundles: /artifacts/3287654321/v26_logs.tar.gz and /artifacts/3287654321/v25_logs.tar.gz. CI alert suppressed for pinned canary.
ben: noted. I'll post a short summary once runs finish with a recommended mitigation (likely pin tokenizer version until kernel/quantized retrain or adjust decoding temperature).
cara: +1. if it's quant we might be able to tweak per-channel scaling as a temporary fix.
alice: great — keeping thread here. ping me if any immediate blockers. :thumbsup:
